entities.summary: George Njaralakatt is an archbishop of the Syro-Malabar Church who was the Metropolitan Archbishop of the Archdiocese of Tellicherry from 2014 until his retirement on 15 January 2022. He was also the first Bishop of the Diocese of Mandya.
